plugins.name: doctrine
plugins.description: Execution doctrine: parallel agents in phases and waves, adversarial red-teaming, looping until confident, ruthless simplicity. Wrappers for coding, web design (the gauntlet loop), debugging, auditing, documentation sweeps, deep research, and document writing, plus doctrine-pane for an interactive terminal session — a router, a switch, a server — in a pane you watch and can take over. Two skills need something installed and neither degrades quietly: the gauntlet renders and judges real pages, so it needs Playwright, and doctrine-pane needs herdr. The other seven need nothing.
